content:
“Daily Show” correspondent Desi Lydic had some advice for first lady Melania Trump after she announced yet another documentary about her life in the White House.

“It will come out this year, and it will be very different, what is in the movie. It’s more conversation, one-on-one with me,” Trump said during a “Fox and Friends” interview on Wednesday.

“Another Melania documentary?” an exasperated Lydic asked. “Melania, I love you, but unless you’re living with Nathan Fielder in this thing, no one is asking for this.”

Lydic asked when the two-part series would be coming out, then played a clip of Trump giving a seemingly confused response.

“It’s coming out any — any day. November, maybe November. We don’t have exact date, yet,” Trump said.

“You don’t have a date yet? You need a more specific timeline than that. It’s a documentary, not your husband’s war,” Lydic said.

Trump also didn’t specify where the series would premiere.

Her previous documentary opened with a limited theatrical release last January. That movie, simply titled “Melania,” managed to rake in little less than $17 million in gross box office earnings worldwide against its estimated $75 million budget. “Melania” received a 9% rating from critics on Rotten Tomatoes.
